name: Pub/Sub
tagline: A Google Cloud Pub/Sub emulator with schemas, snapshots, five subscription kinds, filters, transforms and exactly-once delivery.
stands_in_for: BigQuery, Cloud Storage and Bigtable subscriptions

capabilities.title: Publisher, Subscriber, Schema APIs
capabilities.text: Topics, subscriptions, Pull, StreamingPull, acks, snapshots, Seek and schema revisions over gRPC, with paging.

capabilities.title: Five subscription kinds
capabilities.text: Pull, push (wrapped or unwrapped, with an OIDC token), BigQuery, Cloud Storage and Bigtable; their rows and files are kept.

capabilities.title: Schemas that validate
capabilities.text: Avro and Protocol Buffers in JSON or binary; a publish no revision accepts gets INVALID_ARGUMENT.

capabilities.title: Filters and ordering
capabilities.text: Attribute filters with hasPrefix, NOT, AND, OR; ordering keys wait while one of their messages is out.

capabilities.title: Retries and dead letters
capabilities.text: Nack or a passed deadline redelivers with the retry backoff; past max attempts the message moves to the dead-letter topic.

capabilities.title: Exactly-once delivery
capabilities.text: Expired ack ids fail with EXACTLY_ONCE_ACKID_FAILURE; StreamingPull confirms acks, as ack_with_response reads.

capabilities.title: JavaScript and AI transforms
capabilities.text: UDFs run in QuickJS with Pub/Sub's signature; AI inference transforms are answered by the AI models simulator.

capabilities.title: Import topics
capabilities.text: Cloud Storage, Amazon MSK and Confluent Cloud sources read Stuntman storage and Kafka; any source takes pubsub_ingest.

capabilities.title: Snapshots and Seek
capabilities.text: Seek to a snapshot or a time replays what is retained, with retain-acked and topic retention honoured.

excerpts.title: A topic, and each subscription's view of its messages

callouts.title: Schema
callouts.text: Every publish is validated; subscribers get the googclient_schema* attributes.

callouts.title: Ingestion
callouts.text: An import topic reading a Kafka topic as Amazon MSK, with its state.

callouts.title: Transform
callouts.text: A JavaScript UDF runs on every message before the schema check.

callouts.title: Ordering key
callouts.text: Messages with the same key are delivered in order, one out at a time.

callouts.title: State per subscription
callouts.text: Pending, outstanding, acked, expired or dead after 5 attempts, per subscription.

excerpts.title: Provoke on publish, and the subscriptions

callouts.title: Unavailable
callouts.text: Publish answers UNAVAILABLE; the client libraries retry it.

callouts.title: Ack transient
callouts.text: Exactly-once acks fail with TRANSIENT_FAILURE_UNORDERED_ACK_ID until times runs out.

callouts.title: Dead-letter topic
callouts.text: After 5 delivery attempts the message moves to shipments-dlq.

callouts.title: Filter
callouts.text: Messages whose attributes do not match never reach this subscription.

callouts.title: BigQuery, Storage, Bigtable
callouts.text: Subscriptions that write rows and files Stuntman keeps for you to read.

provoke.name: Topic not found
provoke.what: Publish answers NOT_FOUND, for one topic or all

provoke.name: Slow publish
provoke.what: Each publish waits delay_ms (3 s by default)

provoke.name: Duplicate delivery
provoke.what: A message comes again after its first ack

provoke.name: Transient ack failure
provoke.what: Exactly-once acks and modacks fail and are retried

provoke.name: Push endpoint fails
provoke.what: Non-2xx answers retry with backoff, then dead-letter

provoke.name: Row that does not fit
provoke.what: BigQuery row refused, retried, then dead-lettered

provoke.name: AI transform fails
provoke.what: 429 or 5xx from the model fails the publish

provoke.name: Subscription expires
provoke.what: An idle subscription past its ttl is deleted

advantages.title: Cloud behaviour, locally
advantages.text: Schemas, snapshots, dead letters, filters, exactly-once and push auth behave as in the cloud, not only the basics.

advantages.title: See every subscription's state
advantages.text: One message shows acked here, outstanding there, dead in a third subscription, with delivery attempts.

advantages.title: Sinks without a cloud
advantages.text: BigQuery rows, Cloud Storage files and Bigtable rows are kept locally, so the test reads what would land.

advantages.title: Failures the clients retry
advantages.text: UNAVAILABLE, transient ack failures and duplicates on cue test the retry paths before production does.

agent.prompt: Make sure our shipment publisher survives two UNAVAILABLE errors in a row.
steps: the next 2 publishes to shipments answer UNAVAILABLE
published by the app on the 3rd try; billing pending, audit pending
